# 2 Baruch Chapter 67 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 67:2 — Jeremiah's memorial

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "he-built-a-monument-to-the-righteous" |
| LOGOS | "he built a monument to the righteous" |
| PNEUMA | "built a memorial for the righteous" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Monument' (Syriac: nishba) refers to a permanent marker/record; both 'monument' and 'memorial' are acceptable but LOGOS's term is more literal.

---

## 67:3 — compositions of Jeremiah

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "he-composed many-lamentations-of-Zion" |
| LOGOS | "he composed many lamentations of Zion" |
| PNEUMA | "composed many laments over Zion" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Lamentations of Zion' preserves the genitive construction that links this to the book of Lamentations; PNEUMA's 'laments over Zion' introduces a different preposition.

---
